mainEntity.name: What are SHRED classes at Cave Training?

acceptedAnswer.text: SHRED classes at Cave Training are high-intensity interval training (HIIT) sessions designed to improve cardiovascular fitness, build strength, and increase muscular endurance. These classes typically involve a dynamic mix of exercises using various equipment and bodyweight movements. The goal is to maximize calorie burn and improve overall conditioning in a time-efficient format. Each session is structured to challenge participants at their own fitness level.
